name: School & Family Logistics (Dojo Zen)
auth_model: Bearer DOJO_ACCESS_TOKEN (Authorization header or __session cookie; never in the URL). Enforced when REQUIRE_AUTH=true (on in production); pickup_owner refuses on Cloud Run otherwise.

data_sources.family_calendars: private iCal feeds via FAMILY_PICKUP_CALENDARS (not configured)

tools.name: school_today
tools.summary: Per-child school events and action items due today/tomorrow

tools.name: school_upcoming
tools.summary: Days off, early dismissals, deadlines and events in the next N days

tools.name: pickup_owner
tools.summary: Who has pickup/drop-off on a date (owner = Family calendar the instance sits on)

privacy: Children's names, schools and calendar feeds come from env, not code. Tools return summaries only: no message bodies, photos, attachments or sender names.
